Covers western part of central business district, West End, and Foggy Bottom. Shows proposed bridge from junction of 25th and E streets N.W. across Potomac River to Virginia. Relief shown by hachures. Title handwritten in ink at lower left. Extensively annotated in ink to show spot heights. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. LC copy soiled, fold-lined, missing sections at corners, and mounted on cloth backing. Vault DCP
